data.text:
The No To Oil Price Hike Coalition, transport groups, and other PUV drivers officially launched a two-day transport strike at the LRT-2 Araneta Center-Cubao Station in Quezon City on Thursday, March 26, opposing rising fuel costs. Protesters called for urgent government intervention amid continuing oil price increases. 

📸: John Louie Abrina/MB

Transport group PISTON and allied organizations under the No to Oil Price Hike Coalition stage a protest rally during a nationwide transport strike in Cubao, Quezon City on Thursday, March 26, 2026.
